markdownRemark.html:
Context: There is an increased effort to move into the Gaza Strip, and surrounding countries. Graphic scenes are abound, available for regular people to see.

Kabbalah memes to hide meanings,
World's told it's not what they're seeing,
Disgust is truth for most of us,
The game is to make truth reversed,
Loyalty tested by what's done,
Malice filled down-trodden claimed ones,
Unseen forces favour their clan,
Their temple built on your land,

Tragedy day in and out streamed,
Normalising the horrors seen,
Debating poetic meanings,
To best justify wrong doings,
Codified laws twisted and bent,
The oligarchs know what was meant,
Signal none against may stand,
Their temple built on your land,

Yet to cast off Middle age spells,
There left where the merchants did sales,
scribe noted Roman poet thoughts,
Subversion played out as a sport,
Mind games rather than battles fought,
Power ensures these tales are taught,
Power's is not the Gøds' plan,
Their temple built on your land,

Prophetic visions of the end,
Only evil seeks to defend,
Enlightenment ladders reach hell,
From material realms dwelt,
Up to the hard limit of trust,
Merchants and priests engage in trysts,
Simply because they think they can,
Their temple built on your land.
